page.content:
White watchman of the Bifrost, foe of Loki at the end.

How Heimdall connects

  • Location: Bifrost — Heimdall watches the Bifrost.
  • Faction: Aesir — Heimdall is the Aesir watchman of the bridge.

What is Heimdall?

Heimdall sees and hears across the worlds and will blow Gjallarhorn when Ragnarok starts. He and Loki slay one another in the last fight.

Key threads lead to Bifrost and Aesir.
